name: BOULDER DASH 40th Anniversary
detailed_description:
BOULDER DASH® 40th Anniversary – A legend returns!

Immerse yourself in 40 years of video game history and experience the classic BOULDER DASH® in an epic anniversary edition! Join Rockford on his hunt for diamonds in dangerous caves – more faithful to the original than ever before, yet more modern than ever!

Celebrate 40 years of retro action with a game that made history!

Since its initial release in 1984, BOULDER DASH® has thrilled generations of players. Now, the iconic title returns with a completely new, faithful game engine. A treat for long-time fans and newcomers alike. Your task: Collect enough diamonds in a cave filled with treacherous enemies and falling rocks to open the door to the exit. Here, you not only have to be skillful and quick to react, but also develop a suitable strategy more than once in order to survive. And once you've completed all 180 levels, you can use an editor to not only design new levels, but also download and play content from the worldwide Boulder Dash community for free. Never before has BOULDER DASH® looked better or sounded more spectacular!

Highlights of the 40th Anniversary Edition:

  • 60 classic levels from BOULDER DASH® I, II & III – remastered!

  • 180 brand new levels full of excitement, strategy, and diamond fever!

  • 6 completely new worlds and 3 exclusive fan worlds from real Boulder Dash legends

  • New game elements: Vertically growing walls, acid eating rocks and diamonds, enemy generators, surprise eggs and much!

  • Level editor & community content: Build your own caves or play countless creations from other players

  • Choose your hero: Play with one of three unique characters – inspired by the original design

  • Powerful sound: Accompanied by an epic soundtrack from Germany's most famous video game composer, Chris Huelsbeck

  • Experience the ultimate BOULDER DASH® – for retro fans, puzzle pros, and newcomers alike.

Time travel doesn't exist? Yes, it does! With BOULDER DASH® 40th Anniversary, you can travel back to the golden age of video games – and bring the best of it into the present. Be there when Rockford makes history again!

Download now and relive the legend!

reviews:
“That being said, I did have a lot of fun with Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary, and while this is only a preview version, it’s already clear that it’s near final. It plays incredibly smoothly, and with some good energy that makes it very moreish. Every time I sat down to play, I ended up playing for far longer than I intended to, and I think this one is going to turn some heads on its full release.”
Digitally Downloaded

“Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary promises to be a celebratory edition that honors its glorious past while looking to the future with the right ambition. The love and respect for the original material are palpable in every detail, from the faithful reproduction of the classic levels to the hiring of an undisputed master like Chris Hülsbeck for the soundtrack, while the plethora of new features introduced promise to add unprecedented depth (it's really the case to say) and longevity to the game, guaranteeing hours and hours of fun. Whether you are a veteran ready to dust off your most cherished memories or a new player eager to discover a fundamental piece of video game history, enriched by a fantastic musical accompaniment and an infinite number of levels to explore and create, this renewed incarnation of Boulder Dash seems to have all the credentials to give you an unforgettable experience, a real underground treasure to discover and rediscover.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 2.33GHz or faster x86-compatible processor, or Intel Atom™ 1.6GHz or faster processor for netbook class devices
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c-compatible graphics card with 256 MB VRAM and PixelShader 3.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct Sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT1030 or higher; AMD Radeon RX 460 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct Sound

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS 11 or higher
  • Processor: SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 8800 GT, AMD 5670, Intel HD 3000
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not Required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS 13
  • Processor: SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 8800 GT, AMD 5670, Intel HD 3000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
